achievements.name: Descent From Avernus
achievements.desc: Take control of the nautiloid and escape the Hells.

achievements.name: Bedrolls and Breakfast
achievements.desc: Take four full Long Rests in a single playthrough - adventuring's tiring work.

achievements.name: No Penny Required
achievements.desc: Successfully use Detect Thoughts to pry into someone's thoughts.

achievements.name: Dig for Victory
achievements.desc: Dig up five buried chests in a single playthrough - treasure!

achievements.name: Roleplayer
achievements.desc: Complete ten background goals in a single playthrough - you are one with your character.

achievements.name: Action Surge
achievements.desc: Perform five attacks in one turn. Your enemies won't know what hit them (literally).

achievements.name: Shove Off
achievements.desc: Kill a creature with falling damage.

achievements.name: Fists of Fury
achievements.desc: Kill a character with an Unarmed Strike.

achievements.name: Devil's in the Details
achievements.desc: Defeat Commander Zhalk on the nautiloid.

achievements.name: Bookworm
achievements.desc: Read 100 different books in a single playthrough. Adventuring isn't just daring quests, you know.

achievements.name: Fetch Quest
achievements.desc: Play fetch with Scratch - the best boy in the Realms.

achievements.name: Bottoms Up
achievements.desc: Long Rest using only alcohol - a time-honoured dwarven tradition.

achievements.name: Escapologist
achievements.desc: Break out of prison after being arrested - aren't you daring?

achievements.name: Homebrewer
achievements.desc: Create three unique alchemical solutions in a single playthrough - bottoms up!

achievements.name: Penny Pincher
achievements.desc: Defeat the Toll Collector without her using gold against you - excellent budgeting.

achievements.name: You Have Two Hands for a Reason
Non-Invasive Procedure
achievements.desc: Kill the Surgeon before he performs surgery on you in combat.

achievements.name: Outsourcing
achievements.desc: Recruit a hireling. You can befriend them or use them as cannon-fodder - we won't judge.

achievements.name: Rude, Crude, and Full of Attitude
Kill Two Birds With One Gnome
achievements.desc: Use one enemy as an improvised weapon against another.

achievements.name: Crash Landing
achievements.desc: In the Wyrmway, wait until the dragon is mid-flight, then knock it out of the sky - KAPOW.

achievements.name: Critical Hit
achievements.desc: Complete the game in Tactician mode.

achievements.name: Fancy Footwork
achievements.desc: Defeat Gortash in Wyrm's Rock without activating any traps.

achievements.name: Foehammer
achievements.desc: Complete the game in Honour mode.

achievements.name: Jack-of-all-Trades
achievements.desc: Multiclass into every class in one playthrough without asking Withers to change your character.

achievements.name: Punch Drunk
achievements.desc: Defeat twenty opponents while drunk - down them.

achievements.name: Busker
achievements.desc: Earn a hundred gold from playing sweet, sweet music in a single playthrough.
